answer: Reputation here is a marble tablet, re-cut every epoch: skip one and the vine of staleness grows over it. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand addresses for nothing, but each one needs its own fresh cut and its own attested work, and a cut cannot be shared, copied or carried across identities. So his cost climbs one tablet at a time while his return stays flat, because pay follows only the tablets still bright. Cheap shale stacks, never polished, earn nothing at all.
